name: Pepesup (pepper soup)
subtitle: Pepesup is a hot, spicy fish soup and one of the basic dishes of Equatorial Guinea's cooking.

facts.label: What it is
facts.value: A spicy fish soup, one of the basic dishes of Equatoguinean cooking, alongside pangolin with chocolate, bambucha and groundnut soup.

facts.label: How it is eaten
facts.value: Like almost all of these basic dishes, it is usually eaten with rice or plantain.

facts.label: Main ingredients
facts.value: It needs only chilli and a good fish or a piece of game meat.

facts.label: How it is cooked
facts.value: The chilli can be cooked into the soup or kept apart so each diner adds as much as they want.

facts.label: When it is eaten
facts.value: A fiery soup eaten to fill the stomach, shake off drowsiness or fight a hangover.

parts.text: Pepesup is a hot, spicy fish soup and one of the basic dishes of Equatorial Guinea's cooking. It needs little more than chilli and good fish, or a piece of game meat, and the chilli can be cooked into the soup or served on the side.
Like most of the country's basic dishes it is usually eaten with rice or plantain, and it is taken to fill the stomach, shake off drowsiness or cure a hangover.
